raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

On gfx950, `wvSplitK` picks YTILE 3 or 4 for wide outputs. Once N >= 5 those tiles are up to 4x slower than YTILE 2, so N=5 fell behind hipBLASLt on shapes like an LM head shard (e.g. the draft/target LM head under EAGLE with K=3 and 5 rows).

This PR:
- uses YTILE 2 for N >= 5 on gfx950 (N <= 4 and other GPUs are unchanged);
- lets gfx950 run N=6 through `wvSplitK` where it beats hipBLASLt (M > 1024, 2048 <= K <= 8192).

## Kernel results (MI355X, bf16, µs per call, CUDA graph over rotating weights)

LM head shard M=50016, K=6144:

| N | hipBLASLt | wvSplitK before | wvSplitK after |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 4 | 129.9 | 103.0 | 103.0 |
| 5 | 129.4 | 385.8 | 95.1 |
| 6 | 123.7 | — (hipBLASLt) | 98.1 |

Over a 630-shape grid (M 16–100032, K 512–16384, N 1–6):
- N=5: 35% faster than before on average (geomean), 42/105 shapes more than 20% faster, none slower beyond noise.
- N=6 in the enabled range: 13% faster than hipBLASLt on average (geomean), worst case +7% at M=100032 where both are bandwidth bound.
- N <= 4: unchanged.
- N=7/8 beat hipBLASLt on only part of the grid and stay on hipBLASLt.

Max relative error vs an fp32 reference: 0.4%.

## E2E (MI355X, MiniMax-M3-MXFP4, TP4, EAGLE3 K=3)

vLLM nightly `8e2beaa3` (AITER v0.1.26) plus #61889, which that nightly needs to start MiniMax-M3; the baseline is the same image without this PR. AgenticX: InferenceX recipe `minimaxm3/vllm/mi355x-fp4-mtp/agentic.yaml`, 3600 s per point, one run each (run-to-run noise is about ±3%). Cells are baseline → this PR.

**AgenticX** (selected points; also measured: the previous revision at TP2 C1–C16)

| Conc | Throughput/GPU (tok/s) | P50 interactivity | P90 interactivity | Mean TPOT | P90 TTFT |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 20 | 33,664 → 33,891 (+0.7%) | 201.3 → 205.0 (+1.8%) | 129.8 → 128.4 (−1.1%) | 5.57 → 5.43 ms (−2.5%) | 1.14 → 1.06 s (−6.4%) |
| 24 | 40,256 → 40,332 (+0.2%) | 169.9 → 170.7 (+0.4%) | 97.5 → 98.1 (+0.6%) | 6.80 → 6.72 ms (−1.2%) | 1.19 → 1.14 s (−4.0%) |

The change applies when the draft LM head runs with 5 or 6 rows, about a quarter of the time at C20–C24 and less at higher concurrency, which matches the 1–2.5% lower TPOT.

**Accuracy (GSM8K)**, InferenceX `gsm8k.yaml`, 5-shot, all 1,319 questions, real EAGLE3 acceptance, thinking on:

| | strict-match | flexible-extract |
|---|---:|---:|
| baseline | 96.21% | 96.13% |
| this PR | 95.91% | 95.83% |

Standard error ±0.53%.

## Test plan

- `tests/model_executor/layers/test_rocm_unquantized_gemm.py`: new dispatch cases for N=5/6/7 on gfx950 and other gfx9 (42 passed, 2 skipped on MI355X).
- Kernel timing and accuracy over the grid above, old vs new `wvSplitK` and hipBLASLt.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

@@ -316,6 +316,47 @@ def test_rocm_unquantized_gemm_gfx1x_n_gt_5_falls_back(monkeypatch, m):
     assert torch.allclose(out, ref, atol=1e-3, rtol=1e-3)
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("on_gfx950", "n", "m", "k", "expect_wvsplitk"),
+    [
+        (True, 5, 8192, 64, True),
+        # gfx950 also takes N=6 on wide outputs with a mid-sized K ...
+        (True, 6, 2048, 2048, True),
+        # ... but not on narrow outputs, short or long K, or N=7.
+        (True, 6, 1024, 2048, False),
+        (True, 6, 2048, 1536, False),
+        (True, 6, 2048, 8200, False),
+        (True, 7, 2048, 2048, False),
+        # Other gfx9 parts stop at N=5.
+        (False, 5, 8192, 64, True),
+        (False, 6, 2048, 2048, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_rocm_unquantized_gemm_wvsplitk_batch_limit(
+    monkeypatch, on_gfx950, n, m, k, expect_wvsplitk
+):
+    x = torch.randn(n, k, dtype=torch.float16)
+    weight = torch.randn(m, k, dtype=torch.float16)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(utils, "use_aiter_triton_gemm", lambda *args: False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(utils.envs, "VLLM_ROCM_USE_SKINNY_GEMM", True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(utils.rocm_aiter_ops, "is_tgemm_enabled", lambda: False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr("vllm.platforms.rocm.on_gfx1x", lambda: False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr("vllm.platforms.rocm.on_gfx9", lambda: True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr("vllm.platforms.rocm.on_gfx950", lambda: on_gfx950)
+    monkeypatch.setattr("vllm.platforms.rocm.on_gfx1250", lambda: False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(utils, "num_compute_units", lambda: 256)
+
+    wvsplitk_mock = MagicMock(side_effect=lambda w, x_view, _, __: x_view @ w.t())
+    monkeypatch.setattr(utils.ops, "wvSplitK", wvsplitk_mock)
+
+    out = utils.rocm_unquantized_gemm_impl(x, weight, None)
+    ref = torch.nn.functional.linear(x, weight, None)
+
+    assert wvsplitk_mock.called == expect_wvsplitk
+    assert torch.allclose(out, ref, atol=1e-3, rtol=1e-3)
